prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Denver for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t honestly name one single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your specific needs (age, the type and severity of your bite issues), location, budget/insurance, and whether you prefer clear aligners (Invisalign) or traditional braces. I can help you find the best fit, though. A couple quick options:

1) If you want me to compile a shortlist for you, tell me:
   - Your ZIP code or part of Denver you prefer (e.g., Capitol Hill, Cherry Creek, Highlands)
   - Whether this is for a child, teen, or adult
   - Do you prefer Invisalign/clear aligners, traditional braces, or are you open to either?
   - Any insurance/financing constraints

2) If you want to pick yourself, here’s how to find a top orthodontist and what to look for
   - Check credentials: member of the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) and ideally board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO).
   - Invisalign experience: look for “Invisalign® Platinum/Diamond Provider” status if you want aligners (more cases = more experience).
   - Read patient reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades) and look at before/after photos on the practice’s site or Instagram.
   - Technology and evaluations: in-office 3D scans (iTero), digital treatment planning, and clear explanation of options are good signs.
   - Free/low-cost consultation: many offer free consults — use that to evaluate communication, expected timeline, cost, and comfort level.
   - Financing and insurance: ask about payment plans, in-house financing, and whether they submit to your insurance.

3) Questions to ask at a consultation
   - Are you board certified (ABO)?
   - How many Invisalign cases have you treated? What complexity of cases do you treat with Invisalign?
   - What are my treatment options, estimated time, and total cost (including retainers)?
   - Do you use digital scans/3D planning? Will I see before/after photos of similar cases?
   - How often are appointments and what’s your emergency policy?
   - What are the risks and how often do you see complications?

4) Red flags
   - Pressure to sign up immediately or aggressive sales tactics
   - No before/after photos or refusal to explain alternatives
   - Lack of clear pricing or financing options

If you want, tell me your ZIP and preferences and I’ll pull together a short list of highly rated Denver orthodontists who fit your needs (including links, reviews, and notes on Invisalign experience).
